summary.name: 百度智能云曦灵 (Baidu Cloud Xiling)
summary.one_liner: Baidu Smart Cloud's marketing content platform for creating digital human avatars, AI-generated sales videos, video translation with dubbing, and AI livestreaming.
use_cases: Generating e-commerce promotional videos from product links
Translating and dubbing videos into 30+ or 100+ languages
Building digital employees for bank or customer service channels
Producing enterprise training and knowledge videos
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a suite for marketing content: one-off portrait customization, 2D digital human creation from photos, and 3D avatars generated from text prompts. It can generate e-commerce sales videos from product links and translate videos across multiple languages with lip-sync. Digital humans are driven by ERNIE (Wenxin) large-model dialogue for scripts and real-time Q&A, with TTS voices and voice cloning. Rendering options include cloud rendering over WebRTC/RTMP and on-device rendering for H5, Android and iOS.
notable: Generates sales videos from a product link, claimed 90% efficiency gain
Supports 30+ languages for video translation (100+ countries/regions in another section) with lip sync
Text-to-3D digital human creation and photo-based 2D avatars
Private deployment option for enterprise customers
caveats: Pricing page exists but its content is not shown; cost is unknown
Enterprise customization and private deployment appear to require contacting sales
Efficiency and cost-saving claims are vendor marketing figures
